title: Park et al. (2020): Single-QD blinking and lifetime specimen and measurement
scopeLabel: Admitted main article only: all 15 pages independently read as text and actual images. Local main methods, variants, controls, comparisons and measurement contexts are retained. Downloaded-only supporting information is not admitted and was not opened, read or hashed. SI-only details are missing rather than inferred. Reference geometry is not a measured nanocrystal, interface or coordination model.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
